title: Velvety Soft Indian Quinoa Pilaf
description: A jammy, pillowy, date-night Indian dish featuring quinoa, yuzu-cure, and kosher-friendly ingredients, perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
Heat the ghee in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the quinoa and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the quinoa is tender and the water is absorbed.
Stir in the yuzu juice, salt, and black pepper.
Fluff the quinoa with a fork and garnish with chopped cilantro.
